items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: Harry Dolls and all that. They joined Jelly Roll.

ctx.x: Before I come home. You didn't tell about Jelly. That was around St. Louis, was it?

Well, that's around St. Louis. Only one I know in the band, the Jelly Roll. Jelly Roll was on the road there. He had an old bus. And I was living out on Phoenix with old man Kimball. Old man Kimball, the bass player. So he said, well, Billy, I'm going to join Jelly. I ain't doing nothing. I'm going to join Jelly Roll. And from there, make a trip with him. I said, well, Pop, when you're going back home? He said, well, anywhere is my home now. My son is raised now. That's a little bit of Kimball, a banjo player. He…
